description_en: Queries scaling plans of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 根据查询条件查询集群的弹性计划
name: DescribeElasticPlans

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan.

If you do not specify this parameter, all scaling plans are queried
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。
不填写弹性计划名称将查询所有弹性计划
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

If you do not specify this parameter, the scaling plans of all resource groups are queried, covering the interactive resource group type and the elastic I/O unit (EIU) type.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html operation to query the name of a resource group within a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
不填写表示查询所有资源组的弹性计划，包括Interactive资源组类型和存储加速服务（EIU）。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html接口可以查看集群的资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the scaling plans that are immediately enabled after the plans are created. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
创建后是否启用弹性计划。
取值说明：
true：启用。
false：不启用
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口可以查看集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scaling plan. Valid values:

EXECUTOR: the interactive resource group type, which specifies the computing resource type.
WORKER: the EIU type
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划类型。 取值说明：

EXECUTOR：Interactive资源组，即计算资源类型。
WORKER：存储加速服务（EIU）
parameters.name: type

AutoScale.description_en:
Indicates whether Proportional Default Scaling for EIUs is enabled. Valid values:

true
false
AutoScale.description_zh:
是否开启存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性。
取值说明：
true：开启。
false：不开启

ElasticPlanName.description_en: The name of the scaling plan

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the scaling plan is immediately enabled after the plan is created. Valid values:

true
false
Enabled.description_zh:
创建后是否立即启用弹性计划。
取值说明：
true：立即启用。
false：不启用

NextScheduleTime.description_en:
The time when the next scheduling is performed.

The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
NextScheduleTime.description_zh:
下次调度时间。

格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

ResourceGroupName.description_en:
The name of the resource group.

You can call the [DescribeDBResourceGroup]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html） operation to query the name of a resource group within a cluster
ResourceGroupName.description_zh:
资源组名称。
调用[DescribeDBResourceGroup]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html）接口可以查看集群的资源组名称

TargetSize.description_en: The amount of elastic resources after scaling

Type.description_en:
The type of the scaling plan. Valid values:

EXECUTOR: the interactive resource group type, which specifies the computing resource type.
WORKER: the EIU type
Type.description_zh:
弹性计划类型。
取值说明：
EXECUTORE：Interactive资源组类型，即计算资源类型。
WORKER：存储加速服务（EIU）

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
